about: a PLEASAND village. load it in the game (LOAD, or drop the file on it), or in the harness: node harness/cli.js save-info FILE, node harness/cli.js run --load FILE, require('./harness').open().load(FILE). everything before `state` is for reading; `state` is the game object itself

meta.note: rng holds the dice: loading this (in the game or the harness) rolls what this village would have rolled next, so it goes on exactly as it would have until somebody touches it (in the browser that includes the mouse moving over the field)
